verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL API for querying data and configuring features, with an interactive explorer, plus an official CLI (newrelic-cli) that wraps API functionality for entity search and deployment markers. This constitutes a documented public API surface that can be driven programmatically outside the UI. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s) and no independent hands-on developer corroboration of NerdGraph usage beyond docs.
